ei.title: The growing divergence of American communities is important...
ei.subject: 수능특강Light

fullPassage: The growing divergence of American communities is important not just in itself but because of what it means for American society. While the divide is first and foremost economic, it is now beginning to affect cultural identity, health, family stability, and even politics. The sorting of highly educated Americans into some communities and less educated Americans into others tends to magnify and intensify all other socioeconomic differences. For example, there are vast differences in life expectancy among inhabitants of American cities, and these differences have been expanding for the past three decades. Rather than isolating differences, successful societies create space for them to coexist and enrich the broader community. The divorce rates, crime rates, and political clout of different communities have also been diverging. These trends are reshaping the very fabric of our society.

For example, there are vast differences in life expectancy among inhabitants of American cities, and these differences have been ③<u>expanding</u> for the past three decades. Rather than isolating differences, successful societies create space for them to coexist and enrich the broader community. The divorce rates, crime rates, and political clout of different communities have also been diverging. These trends are ④<u>reshaping</u> the very fabric of our society.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② educating → educated: highly ___ Americans에서 과거분사가 명사 수식(교육받은). educating(교육하는)은 의미 부적합
det.analysis:
✅ ① important: The growing divergence ... is ___ — 주격 보어 형용사, 적절
❌ ② educating → educated: highly ___ Americans에서 '교육받은' 미국인이라는 수동 의미이므로 과거분사 educated 필요. 현재분사 educating(교육하는)은 능동 의미로 문맥 부적합 ← 정답
✅ ③ expanding: these differences have been ___ — 현재완료 진행형(have been + -ing), 적절
✅ ④ reshaping: These trends are ___ the very fabric — 현재진행형(are + -ing), 적절
det.tip: 과거분사(-ed) = 수동/완료. 현재분사(-ing) = 능동/진행. educated(교육받은) ↔ educating(교육하는)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ successfully → successful: 명사 societies를 수식하는 형용사 자리이므로 successful이 적절
det.analysis:

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① which → what: 선행사가 없으므로 관계대명사 what(~하는 것)이 적절. which는 선행사 필요

✅ ② beginning: it is now ___ to affect — be + -ing 현재진행형, 적절
